purpose: Seven visibly different and imposing third forms, with at most two arms and two feet per creature
forms: Paingpaing: gilded ram plate, ruby nose guard, imperial crown
Picpique: amethyst crystal plate, turquoise crystal spear
Zinzéclair: swept cyan hair, storm armour, lightning bow
Bubu: emerald gas armour, golden mushroom helmet and backpack canisters
Glouglou: bronze alchemical exosuit, glowing potion tank
Bobope: amethyst armour, emerald crown, crystal boulder
Big Maille Maille: sunburst crown and incandescent archmage armour
anatomy: Each frame contains one complete body, one head, two arms and two feet maximum. No crossfaded bodies, extra hands, wings or detached sprite fragments.
